critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL: /api/transactions/{id}/with-installment-restore endpoint at line 663 is missing X-Admin-Id header parameter and require_permission() call

Frontend uses the with-installment-restore endpoint for all transaction deletions, bypassing permission enforcement
